reserveReview.rationale: William Buck ASRS 4400 report as of 30 September 2026 23:59 UTC, signed 5 October 2026: AUD 1,880,893.19 at Banking Circle and AUD 9,409,051.86 at Westpac under the AMAL bare trust, both expressly 100% cash, total AUD 11,289,945.05. Percentages derive without favourable rounding from those amounts and the complete reserve denominator. Page 4 states 11,159,088.49 AUDD across nine networks, including 10.00 on ARC, while the individual displayed chain amounts sum to 11,159,088.48; the one-cent reported-total difference is retained, not silently treated as exact equality. The procedures agree account statements and chain confirmations without exception, but expressly provide no assurance opinion and have no independence requirement. Exact institution source keys match the existing adapter; the report does not disclose deposit tenor or reserve-wide insolvency/rehypothecation protections.
